summary: Report the observed state of a newly created agent when a status read crosses the readiness deadline

replay.detail: No stored observations or action receipts are rewritten.

schema.detail: No graph, database, agent resource or JSON success schema changes.

rules.detail: Admission, ordering, incarnation and readiness classification rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Previously, agents new could cancel its first status read at --timeout and report an already-ready agent as starting or not ready. The same absolute readiness deadline now bounds event waiting. A status read can complete for at most two seconds beyond that deadline and reports the ready, waiting or starting state it observed. A read that still has not answered ends with an error saying the current state is unknown, rather than inventing a starting state. Human output names Unknown; JSON failures emit no invented agent resource. Existing transport deadlines and the configured readiness wait are not increased.

downtime.detail: None beyond the normal CLI binary replacement.

manual.detail: No configuration changes are required. On an unknown-state error, use the printed agents show command to inspect the agent without creating another one.

recovery.detail: A slow status read no longer misclassifies an agent that is already ready or waiting for input. The two-second status-read grace bounds the overrun; it is shared across observation work and does not restart a readiness wait or retry a cancelled state read. A genuine starting state still ends at the original readiness deadline after its current observation completes.
